articles.summary: GLENS FALLS, N.Y. (May 1, 2025) – Arrow Financial Corporation (NasdaqGS® – AROW) ("Arrow" or "the Company") announced financial results for the three-month period ended March 31, 2025. Reported net income for the first quarter of 2025 was $6.3 million and fully diluted earnings per share ("EPS") was $0.38, versus $4.5 million and EPS of $0.27 for the fourth quarter of 2024. articles.title: Arrow Reports 1st Quarter Net Income of $6.3 Million, or $0.38 per Share, and Declares 2nd Quarter Dividend of $0.28 per Share
